That error is not from my code — It's from Firebase Console settings — Your domain glowing-panda-9fea1b.netlify.app is not added in Firebase Authorized Domains list, so Google OAuth is blocked. Email/password login will still work, Google login needs this one-time fix.

Fix in 2 Minutes — Add Authorized Domain in Firebase Console:

Step 1: Open Firebase Console

  • Go to: https://console.firebase.google.com/
  • Select project: familyos-e01e5

Step 2: Go to Authentication → Settings → Authorized Domains

  • Left menu → Authentication → Top tabs → Settings (or Authorized domains tab)
  • Scroll to Authorized domains section

Step 3: Add Your Netlify Domain

  • Click Add domain button
  • Enter: glowing-panda-9fea1b.netlify.app
  • Click Add

Step 4: Also Add These (for safety):

  • localhost (already there by default)
  • glowing-panda-9fea1b.netlify.app
  • If you have custom domain later, add that too

Step 5: Save & Test

  • Wait 1-2 minutes for Firebase to propagate
  • Hard refresh your site Ctrl+Shift+R
  • Click 🔵 Continue with Google → Select account → Should work now — No more auth/unauthorized-domain error

Screenshot Path:

Code
Firebase Console > familyos-e01e5 > Authentication > Settings > Authorized domains > Add domain > glowing-panda-9fea1b.netlify.app > Add

Why Email Login Works but Google Doesn't?

  • Email/password auth doesn't need domain authorization
  • Google OAuth is stricter — It checks if the domain requesting Google login is whitelisted in Firebase
  • Once you add glowing-panda-9fea1b.netlify.app, Google login will work for all users

Quick Workaround Until You Add Domain:

  • Or Create Account → Then login with email/password

Perfect — You are in Cloud Shell and cloned the repo! The error is because your GitHub repo only has index.html, but Firebase needs firebase.json file too. That's why it says Not in a Firebase app directory (could not locate firebase.json).

Fix it now in Cloud Shell itself — 1 command to create firebase.json — Then deploy:

In that same Cloud Shell terminal (where you are now), copy-paste these commands one by one:

1. Create firebase.json file:

Code
echo '{"hosting":{"public":".","ignore":["firebase.json","**/.*","**/node_modules/**"],"rewrites":[{"source":"**","destination":"/index.html"}]}}' > firebase.json

2. Create .firebaserc file:

Code
echo '{"projects":{"default":"familyos-e01e5"}}' > .firebaserc

3. Check files are there:

Code
ls

You should see: index.html firebase.json .firebaserc

4. Now deploy:

Code
firebase deploy --only hosting --project familyos-e01e5

5. Wait 1-2 minutes — You will see:

Code
✔ Deploy complete!Hosting URL: https://familyos-e01e5.web.app

Then open https://familyos-e01e5.web.app → Your Business Professional app will be LIVE → Google login will work — No domain error
